verdict.rationale: Fastmail's Filters & Rules feature provides server-side automation that runs autonomously in the background without user intervention, and JMAP API tokens plus EventSource/WebPush push notifications allow building custom automated workflows (e.g., an agent reacting to new mail events). However, there is no evidence of purpose-built AI-agent automation tooling, scheduled/triggered agent workflows, or third-party AI automation integrations. Missing for 10: dedicated AI/agent automation framework or examples, evidence of autonomous multi-step workflows beyond simple filters, independent confirmation of using JMAP for agentic background tasks.
